name: Spool
install: `./mailbench install spool` downloads the released Spool.dmg, from the same URL a person uses, into /Applications.
account: `./mailbench account spool` writes the account into a benchmark profile of its own (Spool honours XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME), so nothing here can touch real mail.
`./mailbench up spool` launches Spool on that profile.
parity: The account is written with initial_limit = 1000000. The default of 2,000 would sync a fraction of what the other clients sync.
reset: Automatic: `./mailbench sync spool` moves the profile's data aside (never deletes it) and launches Spool on an empty store.
